# Offline province/city data

Source: https://github.com/modood/Administrative-divisions-of-China

Pinned revision: `c49d495b40ac73eb1a66f6eeae5f8fd10696f035`.
Original file: `dist/pc-code.json`, copied without byte changes to
`assets/data/music-regions.json` (SHA-256
`809d72fa8f1eca68a6843618ab95a6819f6f42a37ee2d97c573fc5c26d9ad9bd`).

The source is based on 2023 National Bureau of Statistics divisions and covers
31 mainland provincial-level regions. It is an offline account picker, not a
claim that all current administrative changes or worldwide places are listed.
Existing account values outside this list are retained. Municipality district
rows are presented as their municipality city for Kugou's province/city fields.
The original WTFPL license is preserved alongside this notice.
